svg.title: What an ESP-KVM is made of, and what it plugs into
svg.desc: The Waveshare ESP32-P4-ETH board joined by a MIPI CSI-2 ribbon to a Geekworm C790 capture board, with an optional status screen - an I2C OLED or a round GC9A01 - wired to its pins. Ethernet goes to the network, HDMI and USB to the target machine, and USB-C to a supply of its own. Drawn to scale, seven pixels to the millimetre; the wiring is schematic.

g.text: HDMI out, and a USB port
its own supply, not the target

svg.text: a status screen is optional — one or the other. Wiring shown schematically
